final: WITH rental_payments AS (SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id), store_averages AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(total_amount) AS average_amount FROM rental_payments GROUP BY store_id) SELECT rp.store_id, SUM(rp.total_amount), AVG(rp.total_amount - sa.average_amount) FROM rental_payments AS rp JOIN store_averages AS sa ON sa.store_id = rp.store_id WHERE rp.total_amount > sa.average_amount GROUP BY rp.store_id
